flavorText: A Heavy Armor set found in the Sunspire Trial.
name: Weapons: Claw of Yolnahkriin

title: Jewelry: Claw of Yolnahkriin
flavorText: A Heavy Armor set found in the Sunspire Trial.
name: Jewelry: Claw of Yolnahkriin

title: Bound Collection of Fur
flavorText: This leather-bound book contains pages filled with shed Khajiit fur artistically adhered to its pages. Oooh, soft and pretty!
name: Bound Collection of Fur

title: Bitten Terror Bird Statue
flavorText: Once a small soft-wood statue carved into a terror bird, this item now has bite marks pocking it.
name: Bitten Terror Bird Statue

title: Dented Jingleball
flavorText: Crafted from shiny metal, this dimpled sphere is etched with Dagi-raht forms, and it chimes gently when shaken.
name: Dented Jingleball

title: Chipped Sun Catcher
flavorText: This chipped glass orb catches the sunlight and creates beams of colored light in the area.
name: Chipped Sun Catcher

title: The Book of Moons
flavorText: Watercolor illustrations of Khajiit meditating under Jone and Jode fill this art book.
name: The Book of Moons

title: Painted Claw Chimes
flavorText: Each claw is painted with moons in various phases, and tiny bells dangle and make pleasing sounds when moved.
name: Painted Claw Chimes

title: Bag of Doll Eyes
flavorText: This brown linen bag contains an assortment of doll eyes. A paper scrap says 'Bless Sheggorath.'
name: Bag of Doll Eyes

title: Namiira Choker
flavorText: A nearly completed midnight blue silk choker features silver-threaded embroidery of most of Namiira's name.
name: Namiira Choker

title: Wrist Prayer Sheath of Sangiin
flavorText: Crafted from black leather, this wrist sheath has a prayer to Sangiin written with metallic ink on the inside.
name: Wrist Prayer Sheath of Sangiin

title: Sheggorath's Miniature Sandglass
flavorText: This black-sand timer has Sheggorath's name in tiny letters all over it in swirls. It does not measure time consistently.
name: Sheggorath's Miniature Sandglass

title: Minature Slippers of Rajhin
flavorText: Created from silk and leather, these black slippers seem to honor Rajhin given that his name is embroidered within each one.
name: Minature Slippers of Rajhin

title: Mara's Broken Heart
flavorText: Why someone would spend effort to craft this silver sphere, then pierce it and etch "Mara's Broken Heart," on it is a mystery.
name: Mara's Broken Heart

title: Sparkleball's Demise
flavorText: Contained within a leather pouch, this game has players shred as many sparkleballs as possible within a certain amount of time.
name: Sparkleball's Demise

title: Tailcatcher's Chase
flavorText: A player wraps this feathered wire around their tail, then must prevent other players from capturing all the feathers.
name: Tailcatcher's Chase

title: Rajhin's Dance
flavorText: The pyramid objects in this bag are thrown into an area. Blindfolded players must pass through the area without stepping on one.
name: Rajhin's Dance

title: Three-Moons Favor
flavorText: This set of cards is embossed in three different metals and showcases gorgeous illustrations of moons in different phases.
name: Three-Moons Favor

title: Sandleaping Markers
flavorText: Players toss the handful of marbles and gems in this game into a sand garden, then take turns leaping to collect them.
name: Sandleaping Markers

title: Pocket Rules for Akaviri Domination
flavorText: Condensed into a smaller format, this game favored by competitive-minded folk recently came back into favor in Hakoshae.
name: Pocket Rules for Akaviri Domination

title: Sparkfur Prevention Gauze
flavorText: During dry seasons, Khajiit use these squares of treated gauze to prevent static zaps.
name: Sparkfur Prevention Gauze

title: Moon-Sugar Tail Gloss
flavorText: This small jar contains a silky gloss that Khajiit use to brighten and smooth their tails. It smells faintly of moon-sugar.
name: Moon-Sugar Tail Gloss

title: Nitpicker
flavorText: This fine tortoiseshell comb allows Khajiit of all kinds to safely remove nits, tangles, and more from fur.
name: Nitpicker

title: Whisker Curler
flavorText: Now no longer in vogue, bejeweled whisker curlers, when heated, allow Khajiit to, well, curl their whiskers.
name: Whisker Curler

title: Sharpclaws Filing Stone
flavorText: The specially shaped stone within this soft leather sheath allows Khajiit to file, shape, and help shed their claws.
name: Sharpclaws Filing Stone

title: Toebeans Palliative Ointment
flavorText: The light ointment within this crystal phial helps keep Khajiiti paws in healthy shape.
name: Toebeans Palliative Ointment

title: Fur Goop
flavorText: Despite its off-putting name, the goop within this ceramic jar allows Khajiit to remove ink from their fur with minimal fuss.
name: Fur Goop

title: Khajiiti Scrivener's Brace
flavorText: To protect their fur from ink, or their manuscripts from fur, Khajiiti scribes don this utilitarian brace.
name: Khajiiti Scrivener's Brace

title: Scorpion Whisker Cushion Paperweight
flavorText: Some Khajiit like to display their shed whiskers in cushions. This scorpion-shaped cushion has an iridescent metal base.
name: Scorpion Whisker Cushion Paperweight

title: Jone and Jode Gum Sandarac Bag
flavorText: This ornate bag has a linen lining, but the outside is a dark blue velvet with metallic embroidered moons on it.
name: Jone and Jode Gum Sandarac Bag

title: Sapphire-Handled Pestle
flavorText: This pestle has a sapphire handle with a gold band. Dancing Khajiit are etched in the gold.
name: Sapphire-Handled Pestle

title: Chrysoberyl Alfiq Candle Snuffer
flavorText: The handle of this candle snuffer features carved, pouncing Alfiq. The snuffer itself is shaped like an Alfiq's head.
name: Chrysoberyl Alfiq Candle Snuffer

title: Whisker-Handled Spoon Set
flavorText: Wrapped in silk, in this set of five spoons the utensils have handles formed from whiskers in hardened resin.
name: Whisker-Handled Spoon Set

title: Moon-Sugar Spoon
flavorText: The size of this spoon's bowl suggests moon-sugar is best partaken in generous portion sizes.
name: Moon-Sugar Spoon

title: Dragon-Scale Kitchen Knife
flavorText: A Dragon's scale has been shaped into a crude kitchen knife. Why? Why not?
name: Dragon-Scale Kitchen Knife

title: Bone Basting Brush
flavorText: The handle of this brush is crafted from gold-dipped bone, and its use never fails to provide perfectly basted food.
name: Bone Basting Brush

title: Ice-Fire Tongs
flavorText: Created over an enchanted ice-fire, these cooking tongs glow faintly red and blue in the dark.
name: Ice-Fire Tongs

title: Chipped Slab of Ice-Fire
flavorText: When flipped one way, this slab warms items placed on it. When flipped the other way, it cools them.
name: Chipped Slab of Ice-Fire

title: Hungry Cat Sachet
flavorText: A snarling cat face is embroidered on this velvet sachet bag, which contains a mix of lavender and mint.
name: Hungry Cat Sachet

title: Vial of Tears of Hircine's Fallen
flavorText: This lopsided glass vial seems to contain blood. The words 'Tears of Hircine's Fallen' are crudely scratched on it.
name: Vial of Tears of Hircine's Fallen

title: Hircine Kerchief
flavorText: A red symbol of the Hungry Cat decorates this frayed black linen square. Dried blood has stiffened it, as well.
name: Hircine Kerchief

title: Golden Jaguar Powder Compact
flavorText: A paper twist that contains white powder is within this compact featuring a running jaguar chasing a person.
name: Golden Jaguar Powder Compact

title: Hircine Spangled Leather Bracelet
flavorText: This purple leather bracelet has shiny metallic disks carved with Hircine's symbol on its back.
name: Hircine Spangled Leather Bracelet

title: Crying at the Moon: A Collection of Reverences
flavorText: This book contains musical notation and lyrics, with mentions of Hircine. Its spine has a bone writing implement tucked in it.
name: Crying at the Moon: A Collection of Reverences

title: Fur-Removing Beverage Enhancer
flavorText: For those traveling in areas heavily populated by Khajiit, this cup is invaluable. It removes fur from all liquids placed in it.
name: Fur-Removing Beverage Enhancer

title: Alfiq Scruff Access Enabler
flavorText: To reach her own scruff, an enterprising Alfiq long ago invented this specialized gadget. A must-have for all Alfiq.
name: Alfiq Scruff Access Enabler

title: Gear-Driven Facial Massager
flavorText: After being wound up, the three soft brush heads on this tool start spinning, allowing for massages, fur grooming, and more.
name: Gear-Driven Facial Massager

title: Khajiiti Gravity Verification Gadget
flavorText: Once a popular gift, this oblong bronze gadget needs only a slight nudge to fall off the edge of whatever surface it's on.
name: Khajiiti Gravity Verification Gadget

title: Collapsed Box
flavorText: This small, collapsed, fabric-sided box opens and expands into a larger box by pressing a corner.
name: Collapsed Box

title: Sunbeam Focuser
flavorText: The ruby-hued lens within this small bronze device focuses sunlight into pinpoints of light.
name: Sunbeam Focuser

title: Miniature Skooma Pipe
flavorText: A perfect, functional reproduction of a typical skooma pipe that fits in the palm of your hand. There are tiny paw prints on it.
name: Miniature Skooma Pipe

title: Residue Pick and Pipe Brush
flavorText: This flexible reed has a round bristle brush on one end and a pick on the other to clean skooma ash from hard-to-reach places.
name: Residue Pick and Pipe Brush

title: Jone and Jode Skooma Box
flavorText: Carved from Tenmar trees, this pocket-sized medicine box is engraved with a lunar motif of Jone and Jode in all their phases.
name: Jone and Jode Skooma Box

title: Clever Claw Stashbox
flavorText: This steel jewelry box has a hidden compartment that can be opened only with Khajiiti claws placed in the correct recesses.
name: Clever Claw Stashbox

title: Anequine Pipewater Perfumes
flavorText: Several vials of popular scents intended to be diffused in a water pipe to camouflage the smell of skooma smoke.
name: Anequine Pipewater Perfumes

title: Sugar-Tooth Smoking Map
flavorText: A badly crumpled, but detailed map of Anequina's most discreet skooma dens.
name: Sugar-Tooth Smoking Map

title: Durable Twine Mouse
flavorText: A simplistic facsimile of a mouse made entirely of tightly wrapped twine that is popular with furstocks of all ages and sizes.
name: Durable Twine Mouse

title: Lunar Loop
flavorText: A hollow wooden ring with a colored wooden ball captive within. Comes in white or red.
name: Lunar Loop

title: Bony Bed Chimes
flavorText: This tangle of small rodent skeletons is meant to dangle enticingly over an infant Khajiit's cradle to encourage swatting.
name: Bony Bed Chimes

title: Tickle Tail Toy
flavorText: When looped around the tail, this band of downy feathers becomes a fearsome tormentor. Popular among bullies and courting pairs.
name: Tickle Tail Toy

title: Miniature Ivory Manes
flavorText: A handful of small ivory figurines styled after the heroic Manes of the past. Sought more by collectors than children.
name: Miniature Ivory Manes

title: Preening Practice Pillow
flavorText: Some Khajiit give their young these waterproof, fur-covered cushions to practice grooming techniques. It's a little damp.
name: Preening Practice Pillow

title: Savannah Grassware
flavorText: A full nested set of tightly woven bowls with lids that double as plates. Light as a feather and surprisingly sturdy.
name: Savannah Grassware

title: Crescent Moon Pan
flavorText: A sharply curved tin baking pan that is mostly used during moon phase festivals to make seasonal cakes and breads.
name: Crescent Moon Pan

title: Tiny Portion Dish
flavorText: This kind of squat, shallow bowl is commonly used to serve Alfiq their meals, but handily doubles as a condiment dish.
name: Tiny Portion Dish

title: Akaviri Table Vase
flavorText: A brilliant white ceramic vase in the Akaviri style, typically paired with matching ceramic flowers that are sadly missing.
name: Akaviri Table Vase

title: After Dinner Lapping Dish
flavorText: This shallow silver vessel is used to serve sugar-sweetened condensed milk as refreshment at the close of a banquet.
name: After Dinner Lapping Dish

title: Scar Sand Platter
flavorText: This kiln-fired platter had the irregular, wasteland grit of the Scar worked into clay, giving it an earthy, dappled appearance.
name: Scar Sand Platter

title: Iron Thumbcuffs
flavorText: A pair of securely locking shackles for binding a criminal's thumbs together. Nicknamed 'kitten cuffs' when apprehending Alfiq.
name: Iron Thumbcuffs

title: Assorted Claw Caps
flavorText: A bag of an assortment of wooden claw caps of various sizes that are glued on dangerous criminals as restraints.
name: Assorted Claw Caps

title: Khajiiti Service Braid
flavorText: It's a custom among many Khajiit clans for those acting on behalf of an authority to wear a braided lock of that leader's hair.
name: Khajiiti Service Braid

title: Approbation of the Mane
flavorText: A ceremonial scroll of the Riddle'Thar done in gold leaf bestowed upon Khajiit who serve their people with distinction.
name: Approbation of the Mane

title: Bonds of Rajhin's Favor
flavorText: While appearing to be a normal pair of shackles, these bindings are easily removed using a technique known by Rajhin's faithful.
name: Bonds of Rajhin's Favor

title: Comprehensive Guide to Theft
flavorText: A compendium of laws, social mores, and religious traditions outlining in great detail what is or isn't considered stealing.
name: Comprehensive Guide to Theft

title: Cane Sickle
flavorText: This hooked blade was designed specifically for cutting sugar cane. Not to be confused with the sugary treat of a similar name.
name: Cane Sickle

title: Narrow Nasal Hook
flavorText: This delicate iron hook is one of the most misplaced items from an embalmer's kit. Commonly confused for a toothpick.
name: Narrow Nasal Hook

title: Alfiq Cheek Saw
flavorText: A pocket-sized variation of a Senche Jaw Saw. Meant to be gripped in the mouth for woodcutting, but sometimes used by cutpurses.
name: Alfiq Cheek Saw

title: Senche Whisker Brush
flavorText: Made from shed Senche whiskers, this coarsely bristled brush is prized by Senche riders for grooming their mounts.
name: Senche Whisker Brush

title: Baandari Sugar Scale
flavorText: This counterweighted trader's scale takes precise measure of moon-sugar to the accuracy of a single grain.
name: Baandari Sugar Scale

title: Anti-Lock Beak
flavorText: The imposing beak of a large terror bird industriously turned into a frighteningly effective pair of metal shears.
name: Anti-Lock Beak

title: Sharpening Post
flavorText: A wooden dowel wrapped in hefty rope usually kept near a vanity for Khajiiti claw care.
name: Sharpening Post

title: Slightly Chewed Laces
flavorText: This bundle of cloth and leather garment laces is in good condition, aside from some teeth marks along the ends.
name: Slightly Chewed Laces

title: Bag of Squatting Sand
flavorText: Some Khajiit maintain the tradition of sprinkling pawfuls of sand over their private excretions. It doesn't help the smell.
name: Bag of Squatting Sand

title: Highly Flexible Under-Girdle
flavorText: This undergarment somehow supports the back while remaining unrestrictive no matter how it's contorted.
name: Highly Flexible Under-Girdle

title: Stuffed Bird Brooch
flavorText: A colorful songbird, taxidermized and mounted on a thick gold pin for fastening a cloak or to simply adorn.
name: Stuffed Bird Brooch

title: Velveteen Lint Brush
flavorText: A boar-tusk handle wrapped in soft, fuzzy cloth to aid in removing loose fur from the clothing of the infinitely patient.
name: Velveteen Lint Brush

title: Portable Lean-To
flavorText: When unfurled and assembled, this stretch of animal hide can be propped up on one side for those desperately need of shade.
name: Portable Lean-To

title: Engraved Ossuary Bones
flavorText: A handful of loose Khajiiti bones inscribed with funerary blessings from an earlier era.
name: Engraved Ossuary Bones

title: Rodent Skin Bloodsack
flavorText: Somewhat crudely made from the skins of numerous vermin native to the Scar, this empty skin vessel still reeks of old blood.
name: Rodent Skin Bloodsack

title: Lunar Dial
flavorText: The mild enchantments on this stone disc focus the light of Jone and Jode to give an accurate assessment of the hour.
name: Lunar Dial

title: Tenarr Zalviit Clan Amulet
flavorText: The Ta'agra on this weathered bone emblem is so ancient that it wouldn't be readable even if it were still legible.
name: Tenarr Zalviit Clan Amulet

title: Whisker Wax
flavorText: Wealthier Rimmenites often use this sweet-smelling wax to enhance the style and sheen of their whiskers.
name: Whisker Wax

title: Cane-Oil Lotion
flavorText: This grainy, natural ointment soothes even the roughest paws.
name: Cane-Oil Lotion

title: Tenmar Claw-Polish
flavorText: According to an ancient Khajiiti proverb, claws make the cat. This polish never fails to bring out a fingernail's luster.
name: Tenmar Claw-Polish

title: Moonprowler's Musk
flavorText: This potent cologne is a favorite among the Senche-raht--a formidable scent that commands respect!
name: Moonprowler's Musk

title: Pellitine Snout-Powder
flavorText: This chalky foundation is essential for any Khajiit dressing in the regal Pellitine style.
name: Pellitine Snout-Powder

title: Sweetwater Mouthwash
flavorText: The Khajiit are likely the only race that considers sugar essential to oral hygiene.
name: Sweetwater Mouthwash

title: Alkosh Devotional Figurine
flavorText: This wooden statuette resembles a reclining cat with its jaws open wide--a common representation of the chief Khajiiti deity.
name: Alkosh Devotional Figurine

title: Khajiiti Death Coin
flavorText: Some Khajiit believe that Khenarthi will only whisk them away to the afterlife if the price is right.
name: Khajiiti Death Coin

title: Meditative Moon Marbles
flavorText: These marbles resemble Jone and Jode in both color and comparative size, and serve as a prayer-focus when rolled in the paw.
name: Meditative Moon Marbles

title: Prayer Pendulum
flavorText: A length of string with opals affixed to both ends. Worshipers let the stones swing in unison as a reminder of the Riddle'Thar.
name: Prayer Pendulum

title: Torval Ritual Censer
flavorText: This filigreed bronze vessel smells faintly of incense and moon-sugar cane.
name: Torval Ritual Censer

title: Azuran Holy Water
flavorText: This fine silver flask contains sacred spring-water drawn from the wells of the Hidden Moon Temple.
name: Azuran Holy Water

title: Meirvalean Drinking Gourd
flavorText: This traditional bottle gourd carved in the Meirvalean style is considered essential when drinking regional sugar-wine.
name: Meirvalean Drinking Gourd

title: Khrasaat Gizzard-Canteen
flavorText: The gizzard of a full-grown terror bird makes for a very durable waterskin.
name: Khrasaat Gizzard-Canteen

title: Tilted Glimmer-Stein
flavorText: Ancient tradition demands that these lopsided desert-glass vessels must always be shaped by drunken hands.
name: Tilted Glimmer-Stein

title: Senche-raht Wine Bowl
flavorText: Drinking from this gilded bowl is considered strictly taboo for Cathay, Dagi, and other thumbed bipeds.
name: Senche-raht Wine Bowl

title: Clan Mother's Cup
flavorText: Khajiiti clan mothers often drink from opal-studded cups bearing the likeness of Khenarthi, god of the wind.
name: Clan Mother's Cup

title: Mane-Herald Shot Glass
flavorText: Khajiit drink from these finely crafted shot glasses to salute the new Mane at his or her ascension anniversary.
name: Mane-Herald Shot Glass

title: Ripper-Skin Tacklebox
flavorText: This duneripper-hide tacklebox is exceptionally sturdy--perfect for the long desert treks of an oasis angler.
name: Ripper-Skin Tacklebox

title: Senchegut Fishing Line
flavorText: Pricier than standard twine and subject to social disapproval, the intestines of senche-tigers make for stout fishing line.
name: Senchegut Fishing Line

title: Hircine-Fang Fishhook
flavorText: This steel fishhook boasts nigh-supernatural sharpness. Anglers say it could pierce the lip of the Hungry Cat himself.
name: Hircine-Fang Fishhook

title: Riverhold Fishing-Mitt
flavorText: Khajiiti hand-fishing remains a popular pastime for rich and poor alike, but this hooked glove is definitely a luxury.
name: Riverhold Fishing-Mitt

title: Baandari Jaw Harp
flavorText: The Khajiit's prodigious fangs make playing the jaw harp difficult. But Baandari musicians never refuse a challenge.
name: Baandari Jaw Harp

title: Khajiiti Tail Rattle
flavorText: A single twitch of the tail can make this rattle hiss and clatter--a quality that many visitors to Elsweyr find infuriating.
name: Khajiiti Tail Rattle

title: Sugar Cane Flute
flavorText: Once harvested, the smaller stalks of moon-sugar cane are often carved into simple flutes and whistles.
name: Sugar Cane Flute

title: Akaviri Pellet Drum
flavorText: Dazzling Tsaesci inscriptions cover this small, exotic drum.
name: Akaviri Pellet Drum

title: Ziz Kurah Washboard
flavorText: The Ziz Kurah adepts' mastery of claw-strikes makes them surprisingly skillful washboard musicians, too.
name: Ziz Kurah Washboard

title: Moon-Blessed Ankle Chimes
flavorText: The music of these jangling silver chimes helps Twilight Cantors stave off dro-m'Athra corruption.
name: Moon-Blessed Ankle Chimes

title: Smith's Paw Protection
flavorText: Khajiit fur, while sleek, can catch fire when working a forge. These supple leather wraps keep even the furriest forearms safe.
name: Smith's Paw Protection

title: Khajiiti Tail-Apron
flavorText: A twitchy tail can spell disaster for Khajiiti smiths. This leather apron keeps the hindquarters safe from sparks and cinders.
name: Khajiiti Tail-Apron

title: Darkpool Sulfurs
flavorText: This fine yellow powder has a terrible odor, but proves vital when forging certain Khajiiti tools.
name: Darkpool Sulfurs

title: Akaviri Blacksmith's Mallet
flavorText: The darkened steel and ornate design of this smithy hammer make its Akaviri origins quite clear.
name: Akaviri Blacksmith's Mallet

title: Pellitine Smithing Chisel
flavorText: The ivory-chased handle of this chisel bears all the ostentatious details of a Pellitine tool.
name: Pellitine Smithing Chisel

title: Silken Pommel-Wraps
flavorText: This colorful and tightly wound silken wrap is lined with Topal eel-skin. A fitting detail for the finest weapons.
name: Silken Pommel-Wraps

title: Smeared Tu'heiba's Warrant
flavorText: This weathered poster features an artist's rendering of the elusive Khajiiti crime-boss, Tu'heiba.
name: Smeared Tu'heiba's Warrant

title: Elsweyr Public Safety Pamphlet
flavorText: A pamphlet full of pictorial instructions on what to do during a Dragon attack. The figures seem remarkably calm.
name: Elsweyr Public Safety Pamphlet

title: Euraxian Recruitment Bill
flavorText: This handbill depicts Queen Euraxia in all her glory, urging the viewer to join the ranks of her army.
name: Euraxian Recruitment Bill

title: Goutfang Teaching Scroll
flavorText: A yellowed scroll containing the teachings of a Goutfang master. Alas, the symbols are indecipherable for the uninitiated.
name: Goutfang Teaching Scroll

title: Rawlith Khaj Calligraphy
flavorText: A tidy stack of paper bound in red silk. Each sheet bears an elaborate Ta'agra symbol, painted by the steady hand of an adept.
name: Rawlith Khaj Calligraphy

title: Senche-raht Page-Turner
flavorText: Scholarly Senche-raht place this thin wooden implement between their teeth and use its long stem to navigate their books.
name: Senche-raht Page-Turner

title: Tanor the Terror Bird
flavorText: This ugly stuffed terror bird doll is often gifted by rather cruel parents to their terrified children.
name: Tanor the Terror Bird

title: Sali the Senche-Lion
flavorText: There isn't a Khajiit around who didn't own or know someone who owned their very own Sali the Senche-Lion doll.
name: Sali the Senche-Lion

title: Chewed Bosmer Doll
flavorText: This soft-bodied doll resembling a Wood Elf is often given to Khajiiti kittens to awaken their 'warrior's instinct.'
name: Chewed Bosmer Doll

title: Your Friends, Jode and Jone!
flavorText: The big, round bellies and coloring of these plush Khajiit represent the moons Jode and Jone.
name: Your Friends, Jode and Jone!

title: Rajhin the Ragged
flavorText: This patchwork Khajiit doll with a crooked smile is made to resemble the trickster god Rajhin and his humble beginnings.
name: Rajhin the Ragged

title: The Angry Alfiq Plush
flavorText: Based on a common folktale, this particular soft doll is no longer produced after repeated complaints by the Alfiq community.
name: The Angry Alfiq Plush

title: Moon-Sugar Encrusted Tablecloth
flavorText: After many years of sugary crumbs, this tablecloth has hardened to a near unusable state.
name: Moon-Sugar Encrusted Tablecloth

title: Claw-Torn Pillow
flavorText: This well-loved pillow seems to have been kneaded often by a very contented Khajiit.
name: Claw-Torn Pillow

title: Sugarcane Napkin Set
flavorText: Many bright green shoots of sugarcane adorn this colorful napkin set.
name: Sugarcane Napkin Set

title: Lunar Linens
flavorText: Golden moons line the edges of these dark green linens, changing from full circles to thin crescents.
name: Lunar Linens

title: Senche-Lion Fur Lined Blanket
flavorText: The golden fur lining this blanket contrasts beautifully against its red fabric.
name: Senche-Lion Fur Lined Blanket

title: Quilt of Kingdoms
flavorText: All sixteen ancient kingdoms are outlined in thick, black embroidery thread on this rather large quilt.
name: Quilt of Kingdoms

title: Singing Echo Stone
flavorText: Say anything into this enchanted stone, and it will sing the words right back to you!
name: Singing Echo Stone

title: Enchanted Paper Trick
flavorText: This paper dagger is guaranteed to twirl and dance in anyone's hands. Its frail blade, however, makes it utterly useless in combat.
name: Enchanted Paper Trick

title: Sweet Drink Mug
flavorText: The perfect gift for any Khajiit whose sweet tooth has resulted in one too many cavities.
name: Sweet Drink Mug

title: Neat-and-Tidy Hairpin
flavorText: This enchanted pin is guaranteed to keep even the most lavish hairdos neat and tidy.
name: Neat-and-Tidy Hairpin

title: Fan of Chilled Air
flavorText: Tired of the desert heat? Just give this magical fan a wave! Guaranteed to cool you off in the hottest weather.
name: Fan of Chilled Air

title: Sealed Pickled Khajiit Claws
flavorText: These Khajiit claws have grown sickeningly soft after many decades in the jar's pickled solution.
name: Sealed Pickled Khajiit Claws

title: Vial of Rotten Fangs
flavorText: These cavity-covered fangs show the downsides of a moon-sugar addicted society.
name: Vial of Rotten Fangs

title: Moon-Sugar Cough Syrup
flavorText: This throat-soothing tonic is heavily flavored with moon-sugar to mask the medicine's bitter taste.
name: Moon-Sugar Cough Syrup

title: Snout Spectacles
flavorText: The long, rounded bridge of these small spectacles are designed to balance perfectly on a Khajiit's snout.
name: Snout Spectacles

title: Moonlight in a Bottle
flavorText: 'What ails you? Sickness? Depression? A sense of impending doom? Moonlight in a bottle can fix it all! And for a fair price!'
name: Moonlight in a Bottle

title: Khajiiti Tail Splint
flavorText: This ever-handy tail splint comes in a variety of sizes to accommodate the many furstocks of the Khajiit.
name: Khajiiti Tail Splint

title: Mummified Dagi Paw
flavorText: Rumor has it that this ancient paw can grant any wish, though such magic often comes with an unexpected price.
name: Mummified Dagi Paw

title: Preserved Khajiit Ear
flavorText: It shocks and disturbs that someone made this seemingly inedible, leathery treat, much less desired to eat it.
name: Preserved Khajiit Ear

title: Rotten Tail Keepsake
flavorText: This morbid trophy was roughly cut off from a Khajiit's corpse. The smell of rotten flesh is nigh unbearable.
name: Rotten Tail Keepsake

title: Senche-Lion Tooth Tail Loop
flavorText: For the discerning warrior who wants to add a bit of flair to his or her wardrobe.
name: Senche-Lion Tooth Tail Loop

title: Silver Painted Alfiq Skull
flavorText: The large crack on the top of this skull is suggestive of how this poor Alfiq met his or her end.
name: Silver Painted Alfiq Skull

title: Idol of Rajhin
flavorText: Every idol of Rajhin ever made soon finds its way into the pouch of a thief. What better way to honor the trickster deity?
name: Idol of Rajhin

title: Curvaceous Clay Figure
flavorText: A clay figurine in the shape of an extremely lithe young Khajiit, said to help stimulate certain bedroom activities.
name: Curvaceous Clay Figure

title: Antler of the Beast Prince
flavorText: An antler with intricate symbols and details. It is often used in ceremonies devoted to the Daedric Prince Hircine
name: Antler of the Beast Prince

title: The Three Phases of Azurah
flavorText: Three sides of this wood block feature carved cameos of Azurah, showing her Khajiit, human, and mer forms.
name: The Three Phases of Azurah

title: Sugarcane Carving
flavorText: This small plaque covered in delicate carvings of sugarcane shoots is popular among moon-sugar farmers.
name: Sugarcane Carving

title: Golden Dragon Statue
flavorText: A small and extremely detailed statue of a Dragon, likely used in worship in Elsweyr's ancient Merethic Era.
name: Golden Dragon Statue

title: Small Stuffed Bird
flavorText: Throw it, bat it, squeeze it when you're stressed! This little fellow is the perfect pocket companion.
name: Small Stuffed Bird

title: Oversized Feather Wand
flavorText: Hours of entertainment can be all yours with this simple combination of stick, string, and feather!
name: Oversized Feather Wand

title: Hastily Mended Comb
flavorText: In Khajiiti culture, a broken comb curses its owner with failing beauty. Seems like someone tried to reverse their misfortune.
name: Hastily Mended Comb

title: Emerald Sugar Cane Brooch
flavorText: Commonly worn by wealthy moon-sugar farmers, this glittering pendant is sure to impress.
name: Emerald Sugar Cane Brooch

title: Jone and Jode Decorative Clackers
flavorText: Hung on walls, carts, and stalls all over Elsweyr, these decorative percussion moons allow for a divine touch to any decor.
name: Jone and Jode Decorative Clackers

title: Decorative Moody Mer False Face
flavorText: This porcelain mask is painted to resemble an exaggeratedly grumpy High Elf.
name: Decorative Moody Mer False Face

title: Holy Moonstone
flavorText: This chunk of rock is said to have fallen from the Moons centuries ago, though no one is sure how to confirm such a claim.
name: Holy Moonstone

title: Fang of Azurah
flavorText: In ages past, it is said that Azurah would gift her golden fangs to those most loyal to her. Could this truly be such a fang?
name: Fang of Azurah

title: Rid-Thar-ri'Datta's Writing Brush

name: Rid-Thar-ri'Datta's Writing Brush

title: Statue, Yolnahkriin
flavorText: With spread wings, the golden statue form of Yolnahkriin can preside over your home or garden, lending it the majestic presence of a Dragon.
name: Statue, Yolnahkriin

title: Statue, Lokkestiiz
flavorText: Perched on an hourglass, the silver statue form of Lokkestiiz can impress those who visit your home.
name: Statue, Lokkestiiz

title: Moon Gate
flavorText: Add a miniature version of a Moon Gate to your home. It's the perfect size for your favorite housecat! (Just don't try to use it. It's there to make an impression, not actually work!)
name: Moon Gate

title: Banner, Rimmen
flavorText: Show your support for Rimmen's independence from tyranny by hanging this colorful banner in your home.
name: Banner, Rimmen

title: Banner, Anequina
flavorText: The arid northern region of Elsweyr, called Anequina, has bred hearty warriors and pragmatic thinkers, though some have learned to work the land. Show your respect for the traditions of Anequina by hanging this banner in your abode.
name: Banner, Anequina

title: Khajiit Burial Mound
flavorText: Khajiit of Anequina often build cairns of local stone to mark their dead. Perhaps you need such structures for your own land?
name: Khajiit Burial Mound

title: Replica Dragon Horn, Large
flavorText: This replica of the Dragon Horn found in Anequina can lend a certain air of majesty to your home or landscape. You might find cats or even Alfiq making use of it as a comfy sleeping spot.
name: Replica Dragon Horn, Large

title: Replica Dragon Horn, Small
flavorText: Have an alcove that needs a touch of ancient charm? This small Dragon Horn replica is perfection itself for just such a space!
name: Replica Dragon Horn, Small

title: Wrathstone, Replica
flavorText: Rest assured, you won't be releasing Dragons into Tamriel by possessing this replica of the ill-used Wrathstone. (Just don't let Abnur Tharn see it—unless you like pouring salt into wounds.)
name: Wrathstone, Replica

title: Moon Temple Pad
flavorText: That floor that seems so empty? Add some color with this Moon Temple Pad. The rich blue adds serenity to any space.
name: Moon Temple Pad

title: Khajiit Lion Crest
flavorText: This fierce fellow can make any bit of wall look more imposing. An excellent touch for those seeking a sense of dominance over others. As a bonus feature, you can activate him to become a wall torch!
name: Khajiit Lion Crest

title: Khajiit Wagon, Ruined
flavorText: Are you a fan of fake ruins? Do you want to lend a lived-in look to your garden? This Khajiit wagon is a match for both of these décor choices.
name: Khajiit Wagon, Ruined

title: Khajiit Wagon, Merchant
flavorText: Due to an unfortunate mishap, it cannot be used to move goods, but it certainly sets the tone for the area.
name: Khajiit Wagon, Merchant

title: Akaviri Table, Stone
flavorText: This hefty Akaviri table can dominate a room or help pull together the stone elements in your landscape.
name: Akaviri Table, Stone

title: Column, Fatal Warning
flavorText: Sometimes you need to mark an area as dangerous. Or maybe you just want to provide a gentle "please do not bother me" warning to those who would pester you. This column? Excellent for both such scenarios.
name: Column, Fatal Warning

title: Tojay-Raht Statue, Monk
flavorText: Want to bring the elegant solemnity of an adeptorium to your home or garden? This statue, with a Khajiit adept performing a kata, will do exactly that.
name: Tojay-Raht Statue, Monk

title: Riverhold Defense Spikes, Piled
flavorText: Everyone needs these "go away, and I mean it" spikes. Everyone. (Especially those in Riverhold.)
name: Riverhold Defense Spikes, Piled

title: Riverhold Defense Spikes, Tripod
flavorText: Are your neighbors jumping over the wall of your yard and into your garden, disturbing your hard-won natural aesthetic? Just place this tripod where they normally land, and watch the result!
name: Riverhold Defense Spikes, Tripod

title: Riverhold Defense Spikes, Roof-Mounted
flavorText: These roof-mounted spikes signal to those who see them that you are definitely planning to hold your home fast against any nuisances, including Dragons.
name: Riverhold Defense Spikes, Roof-Mounted

title: Projection Stone, Moons
flavorText: Both shiny and colorful, this projection stone shows the phases of the moons. Perfect for your midnight garden or bedroom!
name: Projection Stone, Moons

title: Cage, Small Animal
flavorText: Whether it's skeevers or pebble pals, this small cage can hold the creature or thing of your choice.
name: Cage, Small Animal

title: Barrel, Riverhold
flavorText: A barrel can contain many things, such as, say, skooma stashes. But you wouldn't have any skooma, now, would you?
name: Barrel, Riverhold

title: Crate, Riverhold
flavorText: You might think that a crate is utilitarian, but your housecats will prize it almost as much as they prize the sound of you adding food to their "empty" bowls.
name: Crate, Riverhold

title: Alliance Standard-Bearer's Emblem
flavorText: When you have ten of these Emblems: use a Standard-Bearer's License, purchased from Predicant Maera during Whitestrake's Mayhem, to create a Runebox. You may only earn one Alliance Standard-Bearer's Emblem per day.
name: Alliance Standard-Bearer's Emblem

title: Runebox: Aldmeri Dominion Banner Emote
flavorText: Contains an Aldmeri Dominion Banner Emote. This container can be traded, mailed, and posted to Guild Banks and Guild Stores - however, once opened, the Runebox (and its contents) are bound to your account.
name: Runebox: Aldmeri Dominion Banner Emote

title: Runebox: Daggerfall Covenant Banner Emote

name: Runebox: Ebonheart Pact Banner Emote

title: Alliance Standard-Bearer's License
abilityDescription: When you have at least ten Alliance Standard Bearer's Emblems: Use to consume those ten Emblems, and create a Runebox: Banner Emote. The type of Runebox created is based on your Alliance.
flavorText: This special license fully certifies you as a true Standard-Bearer for your Alliance.
name: Alliance Standard-Bearer's License

title: The Many Threads
flavorText: Cryptic notes from an Alfiq criminal, tracking his fellow thieves and their tapestry pieces.
name: The Many Threads

title: Wax-Sealed Heavy Sack

name: Wax-Sealed Heavy Sack

title: Siege of Cyrodiil Recognition
abilityDescription: When you have at least twenty Siege of Cyrodiil Merits: Use to consume those twenty Merits and create a Runebox: Siegemaster's Close Helm.
flavorText: This time-honored Imperial recognition fully certifies you as a true Siegemaster.
name: Siege of Cyrodiil Recognition

title: Siege of Cyrodiil Merit

title: Runebox: Siegemaster's Close Helm

title: Working Cook's Recipe Book
abilityDescription:
Read this book to fill your mind with missing knowledge, learning all Provisioning Writ Recipes you do not currently know.
If you know some, but not all, of these recipes, this book will fill in the blank spots of your knowledge.
If you know all of these recipes, you will gain nothing from using this book.

title: Aeonstone Formation, Large
flavorText: Mined from various sites throughout Southern Elsweyr, these lumniscent green crystals grant any home an aura of otherworldly splendor.
name: Aeonstone Formation, Large

title: Khenarthi's Windbells
flavorText: These replica bells might not "find things" as Za'ji says, but they lend a visual reminder of Khenarthi's grace to any location. May the winds favor you and yours.
name: Khenarthi's Windbells

title: Dragonguard Sarcophagus
flavorText: The restoration of the Dragonguard and renovation of the sanctum led to a startling discovery: ancient sarcophagi containing the order's honored dead. Fearing future conflict on the island, Sai Sahan has placed these legendary warriors in your charge.
name: Dragonguard Sarcophagus

title: Vine, Moonlit Cove
flavorText: The sacred waters of the Moonlit Cove lend their blessing to the glowing flora that grows within, or so the Khajiit claim.
name: Vine, Moonlit Cove

title: Khenarthic Bell
flavorText: Known for their cleansing properties, Khenarthic Bells abound in shrines and other places sacred to the Goddess of the Winds. This replica bell might not remove corruption, but its presence can remind onlookers to take a moment and breathe mindfully.
name: Khenarthic Bell

title: New Moon Cult Banner, Large
flavorText: Promising much to vulnerable Khajiit, the Order of the New Moon provides a place for them to go. Yet, in halls strewn with banners such as these, many find more than they expect … or want.
name: New Moon Cult Banner, Large

title: New Moon Cult Banner
flavorText: Promising much to vulnerable Khajiit, the Order of the New Moon provides a place for them to go. Yet, in halls strewn with banners such as these, many find more than they expect … or want.

title: Painted Rock, Swirls
flavorText: Few settlements can match the rich artistic traditions of Black Heights. Now, the brilliant hues that guide Khajiit to the Sands Behind the Stars can enrich your personal paradise.
name: Painted Rock, Swirls

title: Painted Rock, Life's Glory
flavorText: With strokes of vibrant colors, a Black Heights artist rendered a vision of the richness of life before starting on the path to the Sands Behind the Stars.
name: Painted Rock, Life's Glory

title: Painted Rock, Heart's Ease
flavorText: The dominating reds and yellows of this rock painted in the Black Heights style can enhance the visual appeal of your garden, plus provide you with a remembrance of those who came before you.
name: Painted Rock, Heart's Ease

title: Map of Southern Elsweyr, Hanging
flavorText: Also called Pellitine, Southern Elsweyr features a port city, several Khajiiti sacred places, an artist's retreat, locations of a scurrilous nature, an Imperial citadel, and plenty of stories both brilliant and dark.
name: Map of Southern Elsweyr, Hanging

title: Senchal Banner
flavorText: The blue and gold Senchal banner features lunar symbolism, reflecting the Khajiit's cultural reverence for the moons Jone and Jode.
name: Senchal Banner

name: Undaunted Opal Shoulder Coffer

title: Nel's Hidden Loves
flavorText: A love song of a bard's admiration for his missing instruments.
name: Nel's Hidden Loves

title: Chime of the Endless
flavorText: This small handheld chime is etched with Khajiiti symbology. When struck it produces an exceptionally clear note. Bring this to the Bards College in Solitude, in Western Skyrim.
name: Chime of the Endless

title: Tenderclaw
flavorText: An ancient Khajiiti esraj. Well used, but in excellent condition. Bring this to the Bards College in Solitude, in Western Skyrim.
name: Tenderclaw

title: Shadow of Rahjin
flavorText: This unassuming lyre is said to have been both blessed and cursed by Rahjin himself. Bring this to the Bards College in Solitude, in Western Skyrim.
name: Shadow of Rahjin

title: Lilytongue
flavorText: An exquisite harp of Altmer design that dates from the First Era. Bring this to the Bards College in Solitude, in Western Skyrim.
name: Lilytongue

title: Sky-Talker
flavorText: This crudely made hand drum inspied the hearts of Argonian slaves. Bring this to the Bards College in Solitude, in Western Skyrim.
name: Sky-Talker

title: Long Fire
flavorText: A tanbur with a provenance linking it to the lost continent of Yokuda. Bring this to the Bards College in Solitude, in Western Skyrim.
name: Long Fire

title: Highmourn Dizi
flavorText: This simple wooden flute is typical of instruments played by the Akaviri. Bring this to the Bards College in Solitude, in Western Skyrim.
name: Highmourn Dizi

title: Jarlsbane
flavorText: A finely carved tablestrings, bearing Vivec's seal and tuned to the traditional Dunmeri scale. Bring this to the Bards College in Solitude, in Western Skyrim.
name: Jarlsbane

title: King Thunder
flavorText: An impressively crafted Orsimer drum with a booming bass voice from the time of the first Orsinium. Bring this to the Bards College in Solitude, in Western Skyrim.
name: King Thunder

title: Jahar Fuso'ja
flavorText: This ornately inlaid qanun is clearly made for Khajiit paws. Bring this to the Bards College in Solitude, in Western Skyrim.
name: Jahar Fuso'ja

title: Pan Flute of Morachellis Hag-Husband
flavorText: A pan flute lovingly crafted from the leg bone of an ancient Nord. Bring this to the Bards College in Solitude, in Western Skyrim.
name: Pan Flute of Morachellis Hag-Husband

title: Reman War Drum
flavorText: A drum of Reman dynasty, certain to have signaled doom for the Empire's foes. Bring this to the Bards College in Solitude, in Western Skyrim.
name: Reman War Drum

title: Half-Digested Document Pouch
flavorText: Once, this held texts important to an adventurer or scholar. It's in your hands, now.
name: Half-Digested Document Pouch
